ayahs.en: About what are they asking one another
ayahs.e2: What are they asking one another about

ayahs.en: About the great news
ayahs.e2: About the momentous news

ayahs.en: That over which they are in disagreement
ayahs.e2: over which they disagree

ayahs.en: No! They are going to know
ayahs.e2: But no! They will come to know

ayahs.en: Then, no! They are going to know
ayahs.e2: Again, no! They will come to know

ayahs.en: Have We not made the earth a resting place
ayahs.e2: Have We not smoothed out the earth ˹like a bed˺

ayahs.en: And the mountains as stakes
ayahs.e2: and ˹made˺ the mountains as ˹its˺ pegs

ayahs.en: And We created you in pairs
ayahs.e2: and created you in pairs

ayahs.en: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
ayahs.e2: and made your sleep for rest

ayahs.en: And made the night as clothing
ayahs.e2: and made the night as a cover

ayahs.en: And made the day for livelihood
ayahs.e2: and made the day for livelihood

ayahs.ar: وَبَنَيۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعࣰ ا شِدَادࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
ayahs.e2: and built above you seven mighty ˹heavens˺
ayahs.tr: Wa banaina fauqakum sab 'an shi daada

ayahs.en: And made [therein] a burning lamp
ayahs.e2: and placed ˹in them˺ a shining lamp

ayahs.ar: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُعۡصِرَٰتِ مَآءࣰ ثَجَّاجࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water
ayahs.e2: and sent down from rainclouds pouring water
ayahs.tr: Wa anzalna minal m'usiraati maa-an saj-jaaja

ayahs.ar: لِّنُخۡرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبࣰّ ا وَنَبَاتࣰ ا
ayahs.en: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
ayahs.e2: producing by it grain and ˹various˺ plants
ayahs.tr: Linukh rija bihee habbaw wana baata

ayahs.en: And gardens of entwined growth
ayahs.e2: and dense orchards

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time
ayahs.e2: Indeed, the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is an appointed time—

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأۡتُونَ أَفۡوَاجࣰ ا
ayahs.en: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
ayahs.e2: ˹it is˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and you will ˹all˺ come forth in crowds
ayahs.tr: Yauma yun fakhu fis-soori fataa toona afwaaja

ayahs.en: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
ayahs.e2: The sky will be ˹split˺ open, becoming ˹many˺ gates
ayahs.tr: Wa futiha tis samaa-u fakaanat abwaaba

ayahs.en: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage
ayahs.e2: and the mountains will be blown away, becoming ˹like˺ a mirage
ayahs.tr: Wa suyyi raatil jibaalu fa kaanat saraaba

ayahs.en: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
ayahs.e2: Indeed, Hell is lying in ambush

ayahs.en: For the transgressors, a place of return
ayahs.e2: as a home for the transgressors

ayahs.en: In which they will remain for ages [unending]
ayahs.e2: where they will remain for ˹endless˺ ages

ayahs.ar: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرۡدࣰ ا وَلَا شَرَابًا
ayahs.en: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
ayahs.e2: There they will not taste any coolness or drink
ayahs.tr: Laa ya zooqoona feeha bar daw walaa sharaaba

ayahs.en: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence
ayahs.e2: except boiling water and ˹oozing˺ pus—

ayahs.en: An appropriate recompense
ayahs.e2: a fitting reward

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَرۡجُونَ حِسَابࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
ayahs.e2: For they never expected any reckoning

ayahs.en: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial
ayahs.e2: and totally rejected Our signs
ayahs.tr: Wa kazzabu bi aayaa tina kizzaba

ayahs.en: But all things We have enumerated in writing
ayahs.e2: And We have everything recorded precisely
ayahs.tr: Wa kulla shai-in ahsai naahu kitaa ba

ayahs.en: So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment
ayahs.e2: ˹So the deniers will be told,˺ “Taste ˹the punishment˺, for all you will get from Us is more torment.”
ayahs.tr: Fa zooqoo falan-nazee dakum ill-laa azaaba

ayahs.en: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment
ayahs.e2: Indeed, the righteous will have salvation—

ayahs.en: Gardens and grapevines
ayahs.e2: Gardens, vineyards

ayahs.en: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
ayahs.e2: and full-bosomed maidens of equal age

ayahs.en: And a full cup
ayahs.e2: and full cups ˹of pure wine˺

ayahs.ar: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوࣰ ا وَلَا كِذَّٰبࣰ ا
ayahs.en: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood
ayahs.e2: never to hear any idle talk or lying therein—
ayahs.tr: Laa yasma'oona fiha lagh waw walaa kizzaba

ayahs.ar: جَزَآءࣰ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابࣰ ا
ayahs.en: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account
ayahs.e2: a ˹fitting˺ reward as a generous gift from your Lord

ayahs.ar: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابࣰ ا
ayahs.en: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech
ayahs.e2: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, the Most Compassionate. No one will dare speak to Him
ayahs.tr: Rabbis samaa waati wal ardi wa maa baina humar rahmaani laa yam likoona minhu khi taaba

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفࣰّ اۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابࣰ ا
ayahs.en: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct
ayahs.e2: on the Day the ˹holy˺ spirit and the angels will stand in ranks. None will talk, except those granted permission by the Most Compassionate and whose words are true
ayahs.tr: Yauma yaqoo mur roohu wal malaa-ikatu saf-fal laa yata kalla moona illa man azina lahur rahmaanu wa qaala sawaaba

ayahs.ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
ayahs.en: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return
ayahs.e2: That Day is the ˹ultimate˺ truth. So let whoever wills take the path leading back to their Lord
ayahs.tr: Zaalikal yaumul haqqu faman shaa-at ta khaaza ill-laa rabbihi ma-aaba

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابࣰ ا قَرِيبࣰ ا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا
ayahs.en: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We have warned you of an imminent punishment—the Day every person will see ˹the consequences of˺ what their hands have done, and the disbelievers will cry, “I wish I were dust.”
ayahs.tr: In naa anzar naakum azaaban qareebaiy-yauma yan zurul marr-u maa qaddamat yadaahu wa ya qoolul-kaafiru yaa lai tanee kuntu turaaba
